purpose: A primary-export zero/blank/unavailable value must NOT become a claim that the data does not exist. Before any such value is reported, a same-dealer / same-period / same-definition alternate in-boundary check is REQUIRED.

states.required_not_performed: The alternate check is required but has not been performed (Gate 4H opens no CRM/browser access).
states.verified_present: An alternate in-boundary source confirms a real value exists; the primary extreme was an extraction artifact.
states.verified_absent: An alternate in-boundary source confirms the value is genuinely absent for this dealer and period.
states.not_verifiable: No alternate in-boundary source can confirm either way.

rendering_rule: required_not_performed and not_verifiable render to the customer as "not verified from available sources"; a value is NEVER rendered as 0 on the basis of a primary-export blank/zero.
boundary: Aggregate-only; Sales-only; no PII; no raw customer values echoed.
seed_rule: Seeded deterministically from IDs whose committed Gate 4G matrix row carries observed_evidence (a concrete observed zero/blank/absent extreme). No checks are fabricated or performed.

checks.metric: closed deals ÷ write-ups (write-to-close rate), per rooftop, per week
checks.relation_to_primary_blocker: primary — the observed zero/absent denominator is material: the write-up-count denominator is ABSENT from the accepted CRM Sales Gross export at all three rooftops (an absent field, not an observed zero)
checks.observed_extreme: Committed structured audit: "CRM Sales Gross has no write-up count; write-to-close denominator unavailable" — the write-up-count denominator is absent (an absent field, not an observed zero) at 21043, 21044 and 21047, so the write-to-close rate is uncomputable.

alternate_check_required.method: Re-read the same field for the same dealer and governed week via an alternate in-boundary VinSolutions view (e.g. the deal/desking log or the Sales Gross detail), under the identical metric definition, and compare. Sales-only; aggregate-only; no PII.

checks.metric: current-week gross-per-unit vs trailing-30-day average gross-per-unit
checks.relation_to_primary_blocker: secondary — the PRIMARY blocker is the missing trailing-30-day history (trend_requires_history); the observed current-week new-car deal counts are context only and do not resolve the trend requirement
checks.observed_extreme: Committed structured audit: "requires trailing 30-day gross-per-unit average; single held week insufficient" — only one governed week is held, so the trailing-30-day trend basis is absent. This is a history blocker, not a zero-denominator blocker.

alternate_check_required.method: Re-read the same field for the same dealer and governed week via an alternate in-boundary VinSolutions view (e.g. the deal/desking log or the Sales Gross detail), under the identical metric definition, and compare. Sales-only; aggregate-only; no PII.

checks.metric: negative-front-gross new-car deals ÷ eligible new-car deals (per rooftop, per week)
checks.observed_extreme: Observed eligible denominator per rooftop — 21043: eligible new-car deals 0 (observed 0 eligible new-car deals — ratio undefined (0/0); UNRESOLVED, never value=0 (0 new-car deals in period (denominator 0; missing is not zero))); 21044: eligible new-car deals 0 (observed 0 eligible new-car deals — ratio undefined (0/0); UNRESOLVED, never value=0 (0 new-car deals in period (denominator 0; missing is not zero))); 21047: eligible new-car deals 4 (4 eligible new-car deals but 2 blank Front Gross — denominator integrity fails; UNRESOLVED, missing is never zero (2 of 4 new-car deals have blank Front Gross; denominator integrity fails (missing is not zero))).

alternate_check_required.method: Re-read the same field for the same dealer and governed week via an alternate in-boundary VinSolutions view (e.g. the deal/desking log or the Sales Gross detail), under the identical metric definition, and compare. Sales-only; aggregate-only; no PII.

checks.relation_to_primary_blocker: secondary — the PRIMARY blocker is the missing trend/threshold basis for a second-order composite (trend_requires_history); the observed current-week new-car deal counts are context only
checks.observed_extreme: Committed structured audit: "second-order composite requires a trend/threshold basis not defined in held single-week data" — the composite needs a directional trend basis (rising volume, falling close) that a single held week cannot establish.

alternate_check_required.method: Re-read the same field for the same dealer and governed week via an alternate in-boundary VinSolutions view (e.g. the deal/desking log or the Sales Gross detail), under the identical metric definition, and compare. Sales-only; aggregate-only; no PII.

checks.metric: composite: show rate (available) × close rate (sold ÷ write-ups)
checks.relation_to_primary_blocker: co-primary — an observed zero close-rate denominator (accepted Dashboard write-up TOTAL = 0) AND an unratified high/low composite threshold both block it
checks.observed_extreme: Committed structured audit: "Show rate is available, but "close rate" needs sold/write-up and the accepted Dashboard write-up TOTAL is 0 (denominator 0); the composite also has no ratified high/low threshold." The close-rate denominator (write-up total) is observed 0 in the accepted week, and no high/low threshold is ratified for the show-vs-close composite.

alternate_check_required.method: Re-read the same field for the same dealer and governed week via an alternate in-boundary VinSolutions view (e.g. the deal/desking log or the Sales Gross detail), under the identical metric definition, and compare. Sales-only; aggregate-only; no PII.
